messages:
Marta: photo drop  Pippin in a sunhat discovered my hammock and is now conducting very serious surveillance. https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T00000-F11111/pippin_hammock.jpg :sun_with_face: :smile:

Ben: tiny inspector hat on point. does Pippin have a badge? :badge: definitely deserves one.

Sam: who made the hat?? it's perfect. pattern pls? my cat insists on couture. :yarn:

Marta: DIY hat, 3 rows of knit + one pomp. posted the quick pattern snippet in thread: `cast on 24, k2 p2 for brim, decrease every 4th row`

Ivy: OMG pompom tilt is a mood. also peekaboo level 100 when he hides under the hammock edge. will you share the boop vid? :heart:

Marta: uploading boop.gif in a sec. fair warning: dramatic slow blink included.

Ben: poll—Should Pippin get an official hammock inspection certificate? 1) Yes, honorary inspector  2) No, he keeps the hammock secrets

Sam: `/:one:` yes, certificate pls

Ivy: `/:two:` secrets are sacred

PollBot: Poll created: "Hammock inspection certificate for Pippin?" Options: Yes / Keep secrets  Current: Yes 1, Keep secrets 1

Marta: also FYI he stole my pen and is now using it as a ceremonial wand. recommend treating him like royalty for the afternoon. :crown:
